newsitem.title: CHINA: China passes business partnership law.
newsitem.headline: China passes business partnership law.

text.p: China's legislature on Sunday passed a law on business partnerships, the second part of a growing legal framework for the new market-style economy, the official Xinhua news agency said.

The partnership business law, which will take effect on August 1, sets rules for establishing and dissolving partnership businesses, their financing and operations and other aspects of partnerships, Xinhua said.
It said the new law includes provisions requiring partnership businesses to follow China's tax code and boosting fines for those who attempt to register fraudulent partnerships.
It did not give further details.

The partnership law joins China's Corporation Law, which was promulgated in 1993 as the government's first step towards establishing a legal basis for the economic changes brought by market-style reforms.
China is working on laws to govern other aspects of the new economy, including an eagerly anticipated law on stock-holding enterprises.
